1.en: And if the thief be found in the breach

2.en: And if the sun has shone upon him
and he shall deliver what he stole

2.ja: ואן לם יכון לה. פליבאע בסריקתה
2.en: and if he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

3.en: And if the stolen thing be found in his hand

3.ja: מן ת'ור אלי' חמאר. אלי' שאה
3.en: whether ox or donkey or sheep
he shall deliver two in place of the one.

4.ja: ואן ארעא אנסאן ציעה או כרם לה
4.en: And if a man grazes a field or a vineyard of his
and it grazes in another's field

4.ja: פליסלם מן אגוד צ'יעתה או כרמה
4.en: he shall deliver from the best of his field or his vineyard.

5.en: And if a fire breaks out

5.ja: ואחרקת כדיסא. או סנבלא קאימא או סאיר מא פי אלצ'יאע
5.en: and burns a stack, or standing ears of grain, or the rest of what is in the fields
5.he: וְנֶאֱכַל גָּדִישׁ אוֹ הַקָּמָה אוֹ הַשָּׂדֶה

5.ja: פליסלם מא יגב פיה. אלמשעל אלאשעאל
5.en: he who kindled the burning shall deliver what is due from him.

6.ja: ואן דפע אנסאן לצאחבה. ורק או אניה ליחפצה לה
6.en: And if a man entrusts to his fellow silver or vessels to keep for him
6.he: כִּי-יִתֵּן אִישׁ אֶל-רֵעֵהוּ כֶּסֶף אוֹ-כֵלִים לִשְׁמֹר

6.en: and that is stolen from his dwelling
if the thief is found, he shall deliver two.

7.en: And if the thief is not found
the master of the dwelling shall come forward to the judge

7.ja: וחלף אנה לם ימד ידה אלי' מאל צאחבה
7.en: and swear that he did not put forth his hand to his fellow's property.

8.ja: מן ת'ור אלי' חמאר. אלי' שאה ואלי' ת'וב ואלי' כל צ'אלה
8.en: whether ox or donkey or sheep or garment or any lost thing
the matter of the two of them shall be brought before the judge

8.ja: פמן צ'למה אלחאכם. סלם את'נין לצאחבה
8.en: and whoever the judge finds in the wrong shall deliver two to his fellow.
8.he: אֲשֶׁר יַרְשִׁיעֻן אֱלֹהִים יְשַׁלֵּם שְׁנַיִם לְרֵעֵהוּ

9.ja: ואן דפע אנסאן לצאחבה. חמאר או ת'ור או שאה. או שי מן סאיר אלבהאים ליחפצה
9.en: And if a man entrusts to his fellow a donkey, or an ox, or a sheep, or anything of the rest of the beasts, to keep it
9.he: כִּי-יִתֵּן אִישׁ אֶל-רֵעֵהוּ חֲמוֹר אוֹ-שׁוֹר אוֹ-שֶׂה וְכָל-בְּהֵמָה--לִשְׁמֹר

9.en: and it dies, or is injured, or is taken captive

10.ja: פימין אללה תפצל פי מא בינהמא
10.en: an oath by God shall decide between the two of them

10.ja: אנה לם ימד ידה אלי' מאל צאחבה
10.en: that he did not put forth his hand to his fellow's property
and the fellow shall accept it, and he shall deliver nothing.

11.en: And if it was stolen from his keeping

12.en: And if it was torn by a beast
and he shall not be liable for the torn animal.

13.ja: ואן אסתעאר אנסאן. שיא מן צאחבה
13.en: And if a man borrows something from his fellow
and it is broken or dies
and its owner was not with him
he shall pay a penalty for it.

14.ja: ואן כאן רבה מעה פלא יג'רמה
14.en: And if its owner was with him, he shall not pay a penalty

14.ja: ואן כאן אגירא. פקד מר באגרתה
14.en: and if it was hired, it has already passed with its hire.

15.ja: ואן כ'דע רג'ל גאריה בכר. מא לם תמלך
15.en: And if a man deceives a maiden who is a virgin, who has not yet been betrothed
he shall pay her bride-price, and she shall be his wife.

16.ja: ואן אבא אביהא אן יזווגהא מנה
16.en: And if her father refuses to give her to him in marriage

16.ja: פליזן לה מן אלורק. כמהר אלאבכאר
16.en: he shall weigh out for him in silver the bride-price of virgins.

17.en: And the sorceress — do not let her live.

18.ja: ומן צ'אגע שייא מן אלבהאים פליקתל קתלא
18.en: And whoever lies with any of the beasts shall be put to death.

19.en: And whoever slaughters to the worshipped ones shall be destroyed
except to the name of God alone.

20.en: And the stranger — do not cheat him nor press him

20.ja: פטאל מא כנתם ג'רבא פי בלד מצר
20.en: for how long you were strangers in the land of Egypt.

21.en: Every widow and orphan — do not wrong them.

22.en: and he cries out to Me
I shall answer him regarding his cry.

23.en: and I shall kill you by the sword
and your wives shall become widows

24.ja: ואן אקרצ'ת בעץ' קומי ורקא. לצ'עיף מעך
24.en: And if you lend silver to some of My people — to the poor one who is with you
do not be to him like a creditor
and do not impose upon him interest.

25.en: And if you take your fellow's garment as a pledge
return it to him at the setting of the sun.

26.en: For it is his only covering
it is the garment of his body
with what shall he lie down?

26.ja: פאנה אן צרך' אליי. סמעת לה
26.en: And if he cries out to Me, I shall hear him

27.en: and a noble among your people — do not curse him.

28.en: Your first-pressed yield and your first-drip offering — do not delay them
the firstborn of your sons you shall give to Me.

29.en: So shall you do with your cattle and your flock
it shall remain seven days with its mother
and on the eighth day you shall give it to Me.

30.en: And be for Me a people who are consecrated.

30.ja: וחיואן מפתרס פי אלצחרי לא תאכלו
30.en: And an animal torn in the open country — do not eat it
but throw it to the dog.
